meta.description: Analyze TF motif accessibility variability across samples or single cells using chromVAR. Use when identifying TF motifs whose accessibility correlates with conditions, computing per-sample motif z-scores after matched background correction, comparing to ArchR / Signac equivalents, or distinguishing motif-accessibility signal from per-site footprinting.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; verified formulas and biology; prose errors filed as MOTDEV-005 and MOTDEV-009

practice_boundaries.detail: Research-only genomics skill with no clinical conclusions

methodological_ground.detail: chromVAR core method sound (hand-check 1e-16); DecoupleR semantics concern scored down and filed as MOTDEV-006, not a principled fallacy in the primary workflow

code_usability.detail: Bundled chromvar_bulk_analysis.R fails at filterSamples on realistic input because colData depth is never set or documented (MOTDEV-001); Signac RunChromVAR snippet does not exist in current Signac (MOTDEV-002)

functional_suitability.note: Core chromVAR route is sound and verified; the shipped script cannot run, the Signac route is stale, and method prose mis-defines deviation and z

reliability.note: No seed, no depth check, no NA guard; failures are loud but undocumented

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is short with routed references; method-reference is long but sectioned

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow table and routing; hard-coded 6-sample condition and undocumented depth input

human_usability.note: Useful decision table; outputs are ID-only and stale numeric expectations

security.note: No credentials or destructive operations; local files only

maintainability.note: License and provenance preserved; version floors stale and unverified snippets

agent_specific.note: Trigger-rich description and good progressive disclosure; some untested advertised routes

key_strengths: chromVAR deviations and z-scores equal an independent hand computation to 1e-16 and a planted signal is recovered
With the depth patch the bulk workflow reproduces known GM12878 vs K562 biology on real ENCODE data
SKILL.md is compact with routed references, a clear workflow table, and JASPAR2024/TFBSTools issue #39 workaround confirmed still needed
License and provenance preserved; decoupler 2.x rename note verified

recommendations.title: Make the bulk script runnable: supply colData depth
recommendations.problem: The shipped script fails at filterSamples because colData$depth is never set or documented (MOTDEV-001).
recommendations.root_cause: Depth requirement of chromVAR filterSamples was not checked.
recommendations.fix: Add a documented total-depth input and set colData(se)$depth before filterSamples; state it is library total, not colSums(counts); rerun end to end.

recommendations.title: Add set.seed and document background randomness
recommendations.problem: Two identical runs differ by up to 1.25 z and the significant sets overlap only 0.88 (MOTDEV-003).
recommendations.root_cause: getBackgroundPeaks is stochastic and no seed is managed.
recommendations.fix: set.seed before getBackgroundPeaks in the script; document seed and niterations as required reporting.

recommendations.title: Replace or pin the Signac RunChromVAR route
recommendations.problem: RunChromVAR no longer exists in Signac 1.17.1 while the Skill says Signac 1.13+ (MOTDEV-002).
recommendations.root_cause: Snippet not re-run against current Signac.
recommendations.fix: Pin Signac <=1.16.0 or give a tested direct chromVAR route; update compatibility, tool table and examples.

recommendations.title: Guard ArchR marker step against NA z-scores
recommendations.problem: getMarkerFeatures fails because sparse cells give NaN z when a motif's peaks have zero reads (MOTDEV-004).
recommendations.root_cause: Snippet assumes an NA-free z matrix.
recommendations.fix: Count NA in the z matrix, filter sparse cells or drop NA cells before getMarkerFeatures, and document it.

recommendations.title: Correct method prose, DecoupleR snippet, and output labels
recommendations.problem: Deviation/z definitions are wrong, the DecoupleR snippet returns tuples and misuses motif z, outputs lack TF names, and several counts and thresholds are stale or uncited (MOTDEV-005 to MOTDEV-012).
recommendations.root_cause: Prose and snippets carried from the source without execution.
recommendations.fix: Rewrite the chromVAR formulas, test or drop the DecoupleR block, name motifs in CSVs and heatmap, and correct the counts, wording and uncited heuristics.
